Reference / http/endpoint

http/endpoint#

Which addresses a client may connect to, checked after DNS and before the socket.

Version: v1.0.0

Synopsis#

HttpClient();                                         // PublicEndpoints
HttpClient(endpoints: LoopbackEndpoints());           // tests, local servers
HttpClient(endpoints: ListedNetworks(IpNetwork(address: IpAddress("10.0.0.0"), prefix: 8)));
HttpClient(endpoints: AllEndpoints());

Description#

Which addresses a client may connect to, checked after DNS and before the socket.

PublicEndpoints keeps a client off loopback, private and other special addresses, which guards against requests aimed at the inside of a network (SSRF). A host that resolves only to refused addresses is EndpointDenied.

Public API#

role EndpointAllowing#

role EndpointAllowing

The caller can inspect both the effective URL and the exact numeric candidate. This capability grants no DNS lookup, socket mutation or implicit redirect.

object HttpEndpointSelection#

object HttpEndpointSelection

A bounded resolution request, not a connection or a record of unchecked addresses. It validates route coordinates eagerly and filters every candidate at lazy startup, retaining exact numeric endpoints for the eventual connector.

HttpEndpointSelection.HttpEndpointSelection#

HttpEndpointSelection(url is UrlParts, resolver is Resolving, access is EndpointAllowing)

The endpoints of url, resolved by resolver and filtered by access; InvalidHttpEndpoint for a URL a client cannot reach.

The URL.

HttpEndpointSelection.endpoints#

async endpoints() is Sequencing<IpEndpoint>

The allowed addresses with the URL's port (at most 256); EndpointDenied when none.
